question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Adequate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sufficient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"adequate"** means enough or satisfactory for a particular purpose. (पर्याप्त)

 
 
• **Example: **The food supply was adequate to meet the needs of the population.
 
 
 
• **"Sufficient"** refers to an amount that is enough to meet the needs or purposes. (पर्याप्त)
 
 
• **Example: **They had sufficient evidence to support their claims.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'adequate'** is **'sufficient'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sufficient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Evaluate **(मूल्यांकन करना): To judge or determine the significance, worth, or quality of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher will evaluate the students' projects next week.
 
 
 
• **Hidden **(छिपा हुआ): Not visible or not able to be seen.
 
 
• **Example: **There was a hidden compartment in the drawer.
 
 
 
• **Reconcile** (मेल-मिलाप करना): To restore friendly relations between or to make consistent or congruous.
 
 
• **Example:** They decided to reconcile their differences and work together.
 
 

3e:T967,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
